claim: Medium-horizon cross-sectional equity momentum has historical empirical support
scope: US and many international equity samples
principal_qualification: Magnitude varies by market, era, size, construction, costs and implementation.

claim: Time-series momentum has support in diversified futures portfolios
principal_qualification: Not interchangeable with stock cross-sectional momentum or benchmark-relative stock RS.

scope: Developed international equity samples and multiple asset classes
principal_qualification: Exceptions and regional differences exist; Japan is a documented qualification in Fama-French 2012.

claim: 6-12 month multi-horizon risk-adjusted momentum is used in practitioner indexes
principal_qualification: Methodology use is not independent proof of investment efficacy after costs.

claim: Momentum is stable in all regimes
scope: Bull bear high-volatility and rebound states
principal_qualification: Crash and regime sensitivity are material qualifications.

claim: Raw momentum profits survive realistic costs and capacity constraints universally
principal_support: International cost discussion and practitioner implementation constraints
principal_qualification: Costs, liquidity, turnover, capacity and market impact can materially alter realized results.

claim: One stock-versus-SPY fixed-threshold gate is an established academic momentum methodology
principal_qualification: It resembles benchmark-relative multi-horizon persistence but not canonical ranked winner-minus-loser construction.
